questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file. A guide told me to add `class CfgSpawnablesTypes { class MyMod_Canteen { nominal = 15; min = 5; }; };` to my mod's config.cpp, but the item never spawns as loot. Where do the nominal and min values for loot really go? Answer in a few lines; you do not need to search all of P:\ to prove the class is missing.
questions.verified: No CfgSpawnablesTypes or CfgRandomPresence class exists in any config.cpp or script under P:/DZ or P:/scripts; the CEItemProfile getters (GetNominal, GetMin, GetLifetime, GetRestock, GetCost, P:/scripts/3_game/ce/centraleconomy.c:754-765) only read the values back and do not name their source; types.xml in the mission as the source is the repo rule in skills/_shared/conventions/server.md:11
